_comment: Numen STT (voice-input) providers. OpenAI-compatible POST {base}/v1/audio/transcriptions (multipart file+model) unless 'backend' says otherwise. Per provider: base URL + known model ids. Model lists refreshed from each provider's docs (2026-07); best-effort, may drift. USER-EDITABLE: this is copied to config/numen/stt.json on first run; edit that file to add your own providers/models or override URLs. The settings 'custom' model escape hatch also accepts any id.
